description: This file implements a processor class 'LangchainProcessor' that integrates Langchain runnables with Pipecat's frame pipeline, enabling interaction with language models via Langchain within the Pipecat framework.

classes.name: LangchainProcessor
classes.description: Processor that integrates Langchain runnables with Pipecat's frame pipeline, handling message processing and streaming responses.

methods.name: __init__(self, chain: Runnable, transcript_key: str = "input")
methods.description: Initializes the LangchainProcessor with a given chain (Runnable) and optional transcript key.

methods.name: set_participant_id(self, participant_id: str)
methods.description: Sets the participant ID for session tracking.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, extracts messages if frame is a context frame, and invokes the Langchain chain with the latest message.

methods.name: str __get_token_value(text: Union[str, AIMessageChunk])
methods.description: Static method to extract string content from either a plain string or an AIMessageChunk.

methods.name: _ainvoke(self, text: str)
methods.description: Invokes the associated Langchain chain asynchronously with the provided text and manages streaming results.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
